# Project Atlas — Vendor Assessment

## Incumbent

The customer statement mailer is provided by Mailwright Ltd, who have held the
contract since 2023. Mailwright handles print production and postal handoff for
roughly eighteen thousand statements a month. The contract renews annually and
the current renewal was signed in January by the VP of Platform.

## Alternative evaluated

Parcelex was evaluated as a second source over six weeks. Parcelex was not
retained for two reasons: their unit price was fourteen percent higher at our
volume, and they could not produce a current SOC 2 Type II report. The security
review recorded the SOC 2 gap as a blocking finding.

## Consequence

Because Parcelex was not retained, there is no live fallback for the statement
mailer. The risk register carries this as vendor risk. Re-opening a second
source is deferred until the reconciliation workstream is complete.
